name: Windham County, CT
findings: Windham County has 322 nonprofit organizations. 165 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 127 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Windham County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 12 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
